title: ws-hwdrivers stream 3: hal_i2c core + buzzer driver verified function-level vs stock (Renode 1.17 cortex-m55), VFP float path

method.emulator: Renode 1.17.0 (vendor/renode-src e8c7c2d), cortex-m55 FPU enabled, bundled dotnet 8.0.425
method.harness: build/ws-hwdrivers-20261122/harness; gen_hali2c.c / gen_drvbuzz.c from autogen.py; meta-driven build2.sh links aeabi mem helpers + matching arm-none-eabi libgcc multilib (64-bit divmod, uint->float).
method.float_support: call_target now loads s0-s3 from the test's float bit-patterns (AAPCS hard-float order: integer/pointer args in r0-r3, float args in s0-s3 by appearance) and, for float-returning functions, moves s0 into the captured return. drv_buzzer exercises this (DRV_BuzzerPlayNote/float frequency, period math).
method.design: stock bodies run in place from stock.app.bin @0x00438000; reconstructed C linked into ITCM. Intra-module calls resolve within each variant. Cross-module callees patched to logging/modelled stubs at their stock addresses: am_hal_iom_* IOM HAL, am_hal_gpio_pinconfig, am_hal_timer/ctimer stubs, osMutex*/osSemaphore*, g2_delay_ms, audio_log_flags/compress_log_output/audio_log_extended. ROM-resident rodata (g2_audio_clock_pin_config @0x78ee48) is left in the loaded stock image (defsym only, no stub/reseed). RAM state (g2_i2c_bus_table 0x20000c4c, g2_i2c_bus_mutex 0x200738fc, g2_i2c4_semaphore 0x2007460c, g2_buzzer_timer_clock_hz 0x20074120, reload tables, repeat/queue state) seeded identically and diffed.
method.compare: return value (void ignored; float return via s0), caller output struct, every seeded RAM region, I2C/stub semantic traces, with stack-temporary address normalization and segment-header validation.
method.inputs: 20 randomized cases per function, stock vs C, log flags 0 and 7. Fuzzing restricted to each argument's valid firmware domain (e.g. buzzer_pwm_config clock_select in 0..3).

hal_i2c.not_yet: all 9 public functions verified; the 6-arg transfer_full/joined now pass via the new stack-argument harness support. begin/finish are inlined-only (no standalone stock symbol), exercised transitively.

drv_buzzer.note: buzzer_period is inlined-only (no stock symbol), exercised via callers. Out-of-domain clock_select (>=16) makes 4<<(clock<<1) a source-level shift >= width = C UB that stock and C compilations resolve differently; this is not a reconstruction defect (guarding it in C would itself diverge from stock). Equivalence holds on the valid clock_select 0..3 domain the firmware uses.

notes: Function-level equivalence only. No sources.json/linker/build changes; no git; no flash.
harness_fidelity_fixes: autogen now treats only GLOBAL ('T') nm symbols as direct test targets; static ('t') helpers (e.g. begin()) are excluded (cannot take &begin from gen.o) and are exercised transitively via public callers. hali2c rebuilt and re-verified 90/90, 0 diffs.
